needs.semantics: If the spell was cast for its blitz cost, the permanent gains haste and 'When this creature dies, draw a card.', and is sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step. `dash` is already an AltCost id with the haste rider, so blitz is dash's shape with a sacrifice instead of a bounce plus a granted dies trigger.
